title: Reported Use of Purportedly AI-Generated Student Accounts in Online College Courses

behaviors.text: An adjunct professor at an unspecified community college reportedly suspected that some [person] in his online art history and art appreciation courses are AI-powered spambots.
These "[person]" allegedly submitted peculiar assignments, such as analyses of non-existent artworks and descriptions of sculptures using painting terminology.
Additionally, their engagement with the college portal is reportedly minimal.
The professor reportedly believed the spambot [person] aimed to fraudulently obtain financial aid by remaining enrolled in courses.
